author: Electricks94
body:
#### PR description:

When a nontrivial class is added as an SoA column, we get a -Wclass-memaccess warning. The reason is that ROOTReadStreamer calls memset for this class to zero-initialize it if no data for it is found on a ROOT file. 

This happens with the [BTLRecHitSoA](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/master/DataFormats/FTLRecHitSoA/interface/BTLRecHitSoA.h) because [DetId](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/master/DataFormats/DetId/interface/DetId.h) provides its own default constructor

This PR introduces a small function that checks if a class is trivially_copyable and not a pointer type. In this case memset is used. Otherwise the data is filled to zero using `std::fill(ptr, ptr + elements, T{});`

#### PR validation:

purly technical change. tested using local unit tests

FYI @felicepantaleo
title: Fix memset in SoA RootStreamer
